statement: Any continuous Hausdorff-valued map constant on every regular ker(gamma) translational subtorus collapses the entire cusp fibre W; the literal continuous Seifert-circle extension asserted in Engel Remark8.3 is impossible.
depends_on: Actual cusp periods and fan; nonreal cusp limit of mu; continuity and Hausdorff uniqueness
notes: The fractional-u limiting-leaf argument retains actual multipliers. This corrects the rank-three Seifert quotient lead and does not affect the smooth delta quotient or C.3.10. No Theta7 value inferred.
